validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case c
JOIN product p
  ON p.product_id = c.product_id
 AND p.name = 'Enterprise Success Plan Variant 3'
WHERE c.channel           = 'social'
  AND c.reopen_count      = 4
  AND c.priority          = 'high'
  AND c.state             = 'in_progress';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case c
JOIN product p
  ON p.product_id = c.product_id
 AND p.name = 'Enterprise Success Plan Variant 3'
JOIN "user" u
  ON u.user_id    = c.assigned_to
 AND u.first_name = 'Amanda'
 AND u.last_name  = 'Austin'
WHERE c.channel      = 'social'
  AND c.reopen_count = 4
  AND c.priority     = 'high'
  AND c.state        = 'in_progress';
